name: Plait
author: E. T. Carter
description: A woven braid of glowing cords runs the width of the frame. Each strand weaves up and down on a phase-shifted sine, so neighbours cross over and under one another like a plaited rope; at every crossing the rising strand rides in front and the one behind dips into shadow, giving a real over-under depth. The whole braid drifts slowly sideways while the palette runs hue to hue across the bundle.

params.label: Strands
params.effect: How many cords make up the braid; few reads as a loose plait, many as a tight woven band filling the frame.

params.label: Weave
params.effect: How many over-under crossings span the width; low gives long lazy waves, high a tightly interlaced weave.

params.label: Weave depth
params.effect: How far each cord swings relative to its neighbour spacing; low barely overlaps, high throws the strands fully across one another.

params.label: Travel
params.effect: Speed the braid drifts sideways; 0 holds a still plait, higher sends the weave coursing across the frame.

params.label: Cord weight
params.effect: Half-width of each cord in CSS px; thin reads as fine thread, thick as fat glowing rope.

params.label: Hue spread
params.effect: How far the palette ranges across the bundle; low ties it in one hue, high cycles colours strand to strand.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo around each cord; low keeps crisp braided wire, high blooms it into soft neon rope.
